answer: Give every identity a weight that grows only with age and sustained honest trade, and decays fast when idle: a new account starts powerless, so a swarm of fresh fakes cannot vote, borrow, or set prices. Weight is anchored to a long, checkable voyage of completed deals, not to a self-declared name, and the nectar of influence — larger trades, better rates — is earned slowly, one season at a time. An attacker must therefore nurse each fake for months at real trading cost before it matters, and letting it idle erases the gain.
